title: Doing more for the cancer causes close to every community
body_markdown:
Catching it earlier


Other partners are focused on helping people take action earlier.[Paddy Power’s](https://www.paddypower.com/bet) partnership with[Prostate Cancer UK](https://prostatecanceruk.org/) has used the platform of the World Darts Championship to encourage men to understand their risk. The partnership's latest campaign raised more than £1.1 million and helped drive around 170,000 completions of Prostate Cancer UK’s online risk checker.


[tombola](https://www.tombola.co.uk/) has taken a similar approach with Eyes Down, Check Up with[Breast Cancer Now](https://breastcancernow.org/) . With one woman diagnosed with breast cancer every nine minutes, tombola is using the reach of its brand to encourage one million people to regularly check their breasts and raise £1 million for breast cancer research and support.


In the U.S., FanDuel is backing[Crucial Catch](https://fanduel.com/about/news/fanduel-supports-nfl-crucial-catch-to-help-fight-cancer) , a partnership between the NFL and the[American Cancer Society](https://www.cancer.org/) that has raised more than $35 million since 2009 to expand access to cancer screenings. FanDuel's support included a donation to the American Cancer Society and a Super Bowl LX sweepstakes, powered by Alltroo and promoted with former NFL quarterback Drew Brees, that rewarded donors with tickets, field passes, and hospitality for the game.


On the other side of the world,[Sportsbet](https://www.sportsbet.com.au/) is in its third year of partnering with the[Australian Skin Cancer Foundation](https://www.australianskincancerfoundation.org/) to fund a mobile Skin Check Truck. Around two in three Australians will be diagnosed with some form of skin cancer before the age of 70. By bringing fully equipped mobile clinics and free, professional skin cancer checks directly to towns and remote communities, ASCF and Sportsbet are helping make early detection more accessible. Sportsbet is also using its sporting partnerships to bring the trucks to major events, reaching people in places where they already come together.
